en: An old monochrome postcard with an ornate illustrated frame around a central photograph of a large, rectangular, three‑storey building on a street corner in winter. People stand near the building on a snowy or bare street. The left side of the frame shows a Swedish-style coat of arms with a castle on a shield, a flag, laurel branches, and a lion resting its paw on a sphere. The top and right borders are decorated with a dragon/serpent motif containing Swedish text. At the bottom, in decorative script, it reads "Svenska Folkförbundets Hem i Kalmar." The card is signed in the lower-right corner "H. Söndberg 1910."
